<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="14" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="18" x2="331" y2="12" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="18" x2="336" y2="10" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="15" r="2.2" fill="#323232"/>
  <line x1="351" y1="11" x2="355" y2="15" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="15" x2="359" y2="11" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="366" y="9" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="368" y="11" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>

  <!-- Gray header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="126" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,76 22,84 30,92" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="84" x2="42" y2="84" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="90" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Check-in</text>
  </g>
  <circle cx="350" cy="84" r="17" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="79" r="4" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <ellipse cx="350" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <text x="24" y="124" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Get your boarding pass and choose your seat</text>

  <!-- Main booking card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="19" y="143" width="352" height="335" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="19" y="140" width="352" height="335" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="39" y="175" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Enter your booking details</text>
  <text x="39" y="198" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Use the details from your confirmation email</text>

  <!-- Booking reference field -->
  <text x="39" y="229" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#403F49">BOOKING REFERENCE</text>
  <rect x="39" y="238" width="312" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="54" y="270" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">e.g. AB12CD</text>
  <line x1="324" y1="256" x2="337" y2="269" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="256" x2="324" y2="269" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <!-- Last name field -->
  <text x="39" y="317" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#403F49">LAST NAME</text>
  <rect x="39" y="326" width="312" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="54" y="358" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Enter last name</text>
  <circle cx="333" cy="350" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="355" x2="343" y2="360" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="39" y="405" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Your booking reference is a 6-character code.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="39" y="420" width="312" height="42" rx="21" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="195" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue to check-in</text>
    <polyline points="298,437 303,442 298,447" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pink accent panel -->
  <rect x="20" y="495" width="350" height="127" rx="14" fill="#DB6186"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="525" r="28" fill="#FFD3D1" opacity="0.75"/>
  <polygon points="322,526 336,519 350,526 336,533" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <rect x="329" y="526" width="14" height="5" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="523" x2="321" y2="519" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="523" x2="351" y2="519" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="40" y="530" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Ready for take-off?</text>
  <text x="40" y="555" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Check in online from 24 hours</text>
  <text x="40" y="574" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">before your scheduled departure.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="588" width="116" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="98" y="605" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Check-in guide</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Assistance section -->
  <text x="20" y="662" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Need a little help?</text>
  <text x="332" y="662" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">View all</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="676" x2="370" y2="676" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <circle cx="43" cy="704" r="18" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <rect x="35" y="697" width="16" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="38,709 38,713 43,709" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="72" y="701" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">How online check-in works</text>
    <text x="72" y="719" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">A simple guide for your journey</text>
    <polyline points="350,701 355,706 350,711" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="738" x2="370" y2="738" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="771" width="390" height="73" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="35,796 45,788 55,796 55,807 35,807" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="32,797 45,786 58,797" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="45" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="123" cy="797" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="790" x2="123" y2="798" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="798" x2="129" y2="802" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="123" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="798" r="17" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <rect x="185" y="792" width="20" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="188,805 188,809 193,805" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="798" r="1.3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="798" r="1.3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="798" r="1.3" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="195" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Support</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="267" cy="795" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="267" cy="806" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="267" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Account</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="340" cy="797" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="797" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="784" x2="340" y2="788" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="806" x2="340" y2="810" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="797" x2="331" y2="797" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="797" x2="353" y2="797" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="340" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
